datasets.name: global_whole_rock
datasets.notes: Exported from PostgreSQL database. Primary input for all geochemical analyses.

datasets.name: earthref
datasets.description: Earth reference chemistry models (Bulk Silicate Earth, UCC, LCC, etc.)

datasets.name: element_info
datasets.description: Periodic table element properties (atomic number, mass, ionic radii, etc.)

datasets.name: ECM1
datasets.description: 1°×1° global crustal structure and velocity model
datasets.notes: Used by src/geophys/ecm1.py. Columns: Hc (total crust km), Hcc (crystalline crust km), Sed (sediment km), VP/VS/RHO per layer.

datasets.name: global_tectonics
datasets.description: Tectonic plate boundaries, plate polygons, provinces, and ocean-continent boundaries
datasets.notes: Run data_access.download_data.download_dataset('global_tectonics') to install automatically. 'location' is updated to the local path after download.
